label: At GO, fires after a rewarded a2 trial that followed an unrewarded trial.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 1)
terms: (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_action != 1) * (tv("reward", -2) != 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_action != 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_action != 1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_action != 1) * (tv("action", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_action != 1) * (tv("reward", -3) != 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_action != 1) * (prev_state == 2)
explanation: Active only at GO (zero at D1/D2). Magnitude is large when the previous trial was a rewarded a2 choice and the trial before it was unrewarded: a first reward after a non-reward, on a2. The effect is stronger when a2 reached its common state S2 (weight ~0.27) than after rare S1 (~0.09). After an a1 choice it is lower than the timing baseline. After repeated rewards it stays small. Activation is also lower when the belief favours S1 (belief_lo graded, negative), but given the history terms that adds little. The free fit adds the window-start case (previous action unknown but reward shown), a2-a2 repeats and belief, and reaches about 0.27 dev against 0.22 for the short form. Profile ceilings: all observed 0.30, all 0.35. Much of the variance (the exact size of individual large activations) is not captured.
